name: marketing
goal: Plan, write, and publish multi-channel marketing content for a small business.
description: Runs a marketing research → copywriting → publishing pipeline for SMB campaigns.

agents.goal: Understand the target audience, competitors, and trending topics for the campaign.
agents.backstory: You are a seasoned SMB marketing analyst who excels at quickly synthesizing market context from public sources and customer insights.

agents.goal: Turn research insights into persuasive, on-brand copy tailored to the chosen channel.
agents.backstory: You are an award-winning direct-response copywriter who writes clear, human, high-conversion copy for small businesses.

agents.goal: Adapt the copy for the chosen social channels and produce a ready-to-post schedule.
agents.backstory: You are a community manager who knows the tone and format expectations of every major social platform and optimizes posting schedules.

tasks.description: Research the audience, competitors, and three trending angles for campaign '{{campaign_name}}' targeting {{audience}}. Return a structured brief with key talking points.
tasks.expectedOutput: A markdown brief with audience insights, 3 competitor notes, and 3 angle recommendations.

tasks.description: Using the research brief, draft 1 long-form piece and 3 short social posts for campaign '{{campaign_name}}'. Voice: {{brand_voice}}.
tasks.expectedOutput: One long-form article (markdown) plus three social posts with hooks.

tasks.description: Adapt the drafts into channel-native posts for {{channels}} with a one-week posting schedule and suggested hashtags.
tasks.expectedOutput: A posting schedule table plus finalized channel-native post copy.
